seo.title: For Businesses · ChatSched
seo.description: Local advertising for South African small businesses, done for you: we plan it, match it with local pages and placements, you approve it. Secure payment, tracked campaigns, proof once it's live.

hero.title: Local advertising, done for you.
hero.subtitle: Tell us your goal, audience and budget. We plan your campaign, match it with the local pages, creators and channels your customers already follow, and you approve it. No ad account, no bidding war. Your placement goes live once your payment has cleared, and you get proof when it's done.

howItWorks.title: From brief to live, in four steps.

steps.title: Tell us your goal
steps.body: Share what you want to promote, who you want to reach and your budget. No ad account and no account manager needed.

steps.title: We plan and match it
steps.body: We build the campaign and match it with local pages, creators, podcasts, radio and community spaces that reach your customers. Prefer to choose yourself? Browse publishers and send a request.

steps.title: Approve and pay
steps.body: When a creator accepts, you get a Payment Card with the total and our bank details. Pay by bank transfer; your placement goes live once the money has cleared.

steps.title: Get proof, not promises
steps.body: Watch your request move from submitted to live, with proof once it's done. No guessing where your budget went.

escrowStrip.title: 🔒 Your payment stays in the ChatSched payment flow
escrowStrip.body: After a campaign is approved, the payment stays in the ChatSched payment flow until the applicable live-placement condition is met. The publisher payout then follows the published payout timeline.

items.q: Do I need a contract or subscription?
items.a: No contract either way. Signing up, browsing and booking are free. You pay the creator's price plus a small booking fee (R30 under R500, R50 from R500) only when a creator accepts. Premium access (R199 per month, optional, cancel any time) unlocks the Opportunities job board and the Marketing Suite.

items.q: How do I know a publisher is legitimate?
items.a: Every publisher and creator is reviewed by hand before they're listed, and carries a visible trust score and level built from real campaign history — not just a follower count.
Once a publisher approves your request, you have {{days}} days to pay. The payment stays in the ChatSched payment flow — not released to the publisher — until the placement is confirmed live.

items.q: What if a publisher doesn't respond?
items.a: Publishers have {{days}} days to approve or decline a request. If it's not actioned in that window, it closes automatically — you're never left waiting indefinitely.
Social media pages and groups, influencers, websites, podcasts and radio slots — all through the same request-and-approve flow.
